title: Obrolan Hangat di Mesin Cuci
theme: Menggali kehangatan dan dukungan yang tak terduga dalam rutinitas sehari-hari, menemukan keluarga dalam komunitas kecil di antara tetangga.

cover.prompt: Apartment interior, early morning, warm sunlight gently streaming through a large window, creating bright spots on the floor. A towering pile of folded and unfolded laundry in the corner of a room, subtly arranged to evoke a sense of a fabric 'mountain'. A child's small, brightly colored toy, like a stuffed animal or building block, rests near the base of the laundry pile. The overall atmosphere conveys a quiet, gentle overwhelm amidst daily duties. The scene is bathed in soft, natural light, highlighting textures and a sense of quietude.
cover.style: Cinematic photography, shallow depth of field, warm color grading

meta.plan_summary: An overwhelmed single mother, Rina, faces a broken washing machine, exacerbating her frustration. A cheerful elderly neighbor, Bu Ida, offers help, turning a mundane chore into a heartwarming exchange of support and wisdom, making Rina realize she's not alone and finding family in her community.
